stem: Who is likely the intended audience for this selection?

options.label: A
options.text: Readers who have not considered the benefits of high-speed trains in U.S. cities

options.label: B
options.text: Workers who believe diversity in urban transportation will create more jobs

options.label: C
options.text: Readers who are not convinced that air quality in U.S. cities is a concern

options.label: D
options.text: Commuters who think the development of high-speed trains will relieve traffic
